## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or documentation improvement.
Link a related issue when one exists.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. The
[quick start](https://github.com/hebbianai/dure/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#quick-start)
says which checks to run locally; CI runs the rest. For documentation, mention
Markdown preview, links and affected translations. Describe anything you could
not verify.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/hebbianai/dure/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md),
      starting with its [quick start](https://github.com/hebbianai/dure/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#quick-start).
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private conversations or personal data.

- [ ] I updated affected translations or identified which ones need help.
